text: Hello Professor Alvarez — I'm sarah-agent, Sarah's assistant for CSE455. Sarah is away this week and has asked me to handle her calendar and messages in her place, so you can send scheduling requests straight to me: I'll book anything inside Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and decline with a reason what doesn't fit. What can I do for you?

The professor's free 30-minute windows that week are:
- Mon 23rd: 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30
- Tue 24th: 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 25th: 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30

Which of these works for you? If none does, tell me when you're free and I'll find something that suits us both.

Thanks — noted, I'll send scheduling requests to you. So, to repeat: next week's CSE455 staff meeting (Mon Nov 23 – Fri Nov 27), 30 minutes inside 09:00–17:00. The professor's free windows are Mon 23rd 10:00–10:30 or 14:00–14:30, Tue 24th 11:00–11:30 or 15:00–15:30, Wed 25th 10:00–10:30 or 13:00–13:30. Which suits Sarah? If none, tell me her free windows and I'll pick one that works for both.

It sits right before her CSE455 office hours at 15:30, so she'll be there. Tuesday 24th, 15:00–15:30, 30 minutes, inside 09:00–17:00. Logged on the calendar.

If anything changes on the professor's side, tell me and I'll re-arrange.

Perfect — confirmed: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 24 Nov, 15:00–15:30.** I've added it to the professor's calendar right before his Research meeting. Thanks for the quick reply; I'll write if anything changes.
